title: Call Centre Advisor
description:
DK Recruitment are seeking a Call Centre Advisor to join a busy customer service team in Plymouth. This is a great opportunity for someone with strong communication skills, a confident telephone manner and good IT skills who enjoys helping customers and working in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities:
- Handle incoming customer calls.
- Record customer requests accurately and ensure jobs are allocated promptly.
- Monitor and chase outstanding jobs to ensure agreed targets and timescales are met.
- Provide a high level of customer service, keeping customers informed throughout the process.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure data is entered correctly into company systems.
- Follow company procedures and quality standards.
- Identify and escalate issues where further support or approval is required.
- Work closely with colleagues to ensure the smooth running of daily operations.
- Complete general administrative duties as required.

The Ideal Candidate:
- Previous experience in a call centre or customer service role.
- Excellent communication and active listening skills.
- Confident using computers and customer management systems.
- Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry skills.
- Able to work well under pressure and manage multiple tasks.
- A proactive approach, with the ability to use initiative when required.
- A reliable team player with a positive attitude.

title: Customer Service Assistant
description:
Customer Services Assistant - Accessories Customer Service Assistant Customer Service Administrator

Plymouth, PL6 Customer Services Accessories Order Processing Administrative Support

Introduction

Acorn by Synergie is recruiting a Customer Services Assistant - Accessories to join a customer-focused team in Plymouth, PL6.

This role plays a vital part in delivering exceptional customer support for accessory products and services. Acting as a key point of contact for customers, you'll support the end-to-end order fulfilment process, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction, order accuracy and operational efficiency.

Working closely with customers and internal departments, you'll help manage customer orders, maintain accurate delivery information and resolve enquiries in a professional and timely manner.

What We Offer
- Opportunity to join a dynamic customer services team.
- Varied role combining customer service, order processing and administrative responsibilities.
- Opportunity to work closely with Planning, Production, Purchasing, Warehouse, Logistics and Finance teams.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities to maintain product, system and process knowledge.

Key Responsibilities
- Act as the first point of contact for customers regarding accessory products, orders, deliveries and related enquiries.
- Respond professionally and efficiently to customer enquiries via telephone, email and customer portals.
- Build and maintain positive working relationships with customers through excellent service delivery.
- Provide accurate and timely information regarding order status, lead times, product availability and delivery schedules.
- Escalate complex customer issues to the appropriate departments or management when required.
- Support the resolution of customer concerns and ensure queries are followed through to completion.
- Process customer orders accurately within SAP and other business systems.
- Verify purchase orders and customer requirements, including part numbers, product specifications, quantities, pricing information and delivery details.
- Generate and issue order acknowledgements to customers in a timely manner.
- Maintain complete and accurate customer order records.
- Monitor open orders and proactively identify potential delivery issues or delays.
- Support the management of order backlogs and overdue orders.
- Act as a communication link between customers and internal departments to support smooth order fulfilment.
- Work closely with Planning, Production, Purchasing, Warehouse, Logistics and Finance teams to coordinate customer requirements.
- Assist in resolving order discrepancies, delivery issues and supply chain-related queries.
- Maintain and update customer records, delivery schedules and order information within company systems.
- Update customer portals, order tracking systems and relevant databases.
- Prepare and maintain reports relating to order backlogs, overdue orders, customer deliveries and service performance metrics.
- Generate routine administrative documentation to support the Customer Services function.
- Ensure all records are maintained accurately and in accordance with company procedures.
- Follow established customer service and order management procedures.
- Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes and administrative efficiency.
- Support initiatives aimed at improving customer satisfaction, delivery performance and order accuracy.
- Participate in training and development activities.

Requirements

Essential:
- Previous experience in a customer service, sales administration, order processing or customer support role.
- Experience managing customer enquiries in a fast-paced business environment.
- Experience working with structured administrative processes and systems.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong customer service and relationship management abilities.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines.
- Competent user of Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Good problem-solving and decision-making skills within defined procedures.
- Understanding of customer service principles and professional business communication.
- Knowledge of order processing and administration procedures.
- Awareness of delivery and supply chain processes.

Desirable:
- Experience using SAP or similar ERP systems.
- Experience working with CRM systems, customer portals or order-management systems.
- Understanding of order fulfilment processes and inventory management.
- Knowledge of logistics, warehouse operations and distribution activities.
- Previous experience within manufacturing, engineering, logistics, supply chain or industrial environments.

Interested?

If you're looking for your next opportunity as a Customer Services Assistant, Customer Service Assistant or Customer Service Administrator in Plymouth, PL6, apply today.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and customer-focused professional to develop their career in customer service, order processing, sales administration and order fulfilment, while supporting customers throughout the full order lifecycle.

Acorn by Synergie acts as an employment business for the supply of temporary workers.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Job Type: Part-time, Initially temporary however could move to permanent for the right candidate.
Location: Plymouth, PL6
Salary: £15 per hour

A growing children's activity provider is looking for a Finance Assistant to join its office-based team in Plymouth. This established part-time role offers 15 hours per week and would suit someone with strong bookkeeping experience and excellent Xero knowledge. The Finance Assistant will play an important role in keeping financial records accurate, supporting payroll processes, and helping the business maintain efficient financial operations as it continues to grow.

Day to day of the role
- Complete the full bookkeeping cycle in Xero, including invoicing, sales input, bank reconciliations, intercompany loans, and balance sheet journals
- Liaise with the outsourced payroll provider to help ensure monthly payroll is accurate and submitted on time
- Support month-end processes and ensure reporting deadlines are met
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records across the business
- Work closely with the wider office team to support smooth day-to-day finance operations
- Assist in improving financial procedures and ways of working
- Provide reliable finance support to a busy and expanding organisation
- Work alongside the Financial Director, receiving ongoing support and development in the Finance Assistant position

Required Skills & Qualifications
- Previous bookkeeping experience is essential
- Strong working knowledge of Xero is essential
- Payroll knowledge would be beneficial
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial data
- Well-organised, self-motivated, and able to manage workloads effectively
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with colleagues
- Comfortable working in an office-based role as part of a supportive team
- A positive approach and willingness to grow within the role

Benefits
- Competitive pay of £15 per hour
- Flexible scheduling with a school-hours focus
- Excellent work-life balance
- Direct mentorship from a qualified Financial Director
- Clear opportunities for development as the business expands
- Holiday care cover available for parents during school holiday periods
- Immediate start available for the right candidate

How to apply

Click Apply Now with your up to date CV or contact Kyle Raven from the Reed Plymouth Office.

title: Resource Management Planner
description:
Adecco are pleased to be recruiting for a Resource Management Planner to work within the Devon & Cornwall Police Force

Location: Plymouth
Contract Type: Temporary
Hourly Rate: 14.10 per hour
End Date: February 2027
Working Pattern: Full Time, Monday to Friday 37 hours per week

Please note this role is subject to POLICE VETTING you must have been residing within the UK for a minimum of 5 years

Are you passionate about resource management and planning? Our client is seeking a dedicated and skilled Resource Planner to join their team in Plymouth. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to operational policing by ensuring optimal staffing levels and responding effectively to the dynamic demands of the organisation.

Key Responsibilities:

As the Resource Planner, you will play a pivotal role in delivering effective resource plans to meet the diverse needs of various business areas. Your main responsibilities will include:
- Maintaining Staffing Levels: Ensure adequate staffing for daily policing activities and planned or spontaneous operations.
- Addressing Shortfalls: Proactively identify and report any staffing shortfalls, escalating issues as necessary.
- Data Management: Accurately record data within the Force IT Systems to enable the creation of comprehensive resource plans.
- First Point of Contact: Provide professional and courteous support for resource management inquiries, handling requests and issues with confidence.
- Skill Base Maintenance: Support the upkeep of the organisational skill base, ensuring staff have the appropriate training and skills.
- Reporting & Analysis: Produce insightful reports to aid managers in making informed resourcing decisions.

Essential Qualifications and Skills:

To thrive in this role, candidates should possess:
- A solid understanding of resource management and planning, along with knowledge of relevant IT systems.
- Familiarity with Working Time Regulations.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, enabling effective interaction with staff at all levels, including senior officers.
- Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel, Teams, and Outlook.
- The ability to analyse large data sets and quickly identify gaps or inconsistencies.
- Proven experience of working under pressure and meeting tight deadlines.
- Strong negotiation and influencing skills.

Competency Framework:

The ideal candidate will embody the following competencies:
- Emotional awareness
- Ownership and accountability
- Collaboration and teamwork
- Support and inspiration
- Critical analysis
- Innovation and open-mindedness

Why Join Our Client?

This temporary position offers a unique chance to be part of an organisation that plays a vital role in public safety. The successful applicant will benefit from a supportive environment where they can develop their skills and contribute to meaningful outcomes.

If you are looking for a rewarding opportunity to utilise your resource planning expertise, don't miss out!

How to Apply:

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply by submitting their CV and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience. The selection process will focus on identifying individuals who align with the organisational values and can contribute positively to the team.

Become a key player in ensuring that the organisation meets its staffing needs effectively. Apply today and take the next step in your professional journey!

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

title: Scheduling Co-ordinator Part time
description:
Scheduling Coordinator - Part time

Location: Plymouth
Reports to: Branch Manager
Hours: Part-time, 2-3 days per week (up to 22 hours)
Salary: 26,400 per annum (pro rata)

About Universal Fire & Security

Universal Fire & Security is a trusted provider of fire and security solutions, delivering high-quality installation, maintenance, and support services to customers across the region. As part of the growing Ranger Group, we are proud to be part of a nationwide network of specialist businesses committed to raising industry standards and providing complete peace of mind for our clients.

We are looking for an organised and proactive Scheduling Coordinator to join our team in Plymouth. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys coordinating people, managing schedules, building customer relationships, and contributing to the success of a growing business.

The Role

As Scheduling Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring the efficient delivery of installation projects. You will be responsible for managing engineer schedules, coordinating resources, liaising with customers, and supporting the wider installation team to ensure projects are completed smoothly and on time.

This position is ideal for an adaptable individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is keen to develop their skills as the business continues to grow.

Key Responsibilities

Scheduling & Coordination
- Manage engineer diaries and schedule installation, pre-installation, and after-care visits.
- Coordinate site visits for engineers and sales personnel.
- Liaise with engineers to support efficient project delivery and workflow planning.
- Maintain project planners and track installation progress.
- Attend installation and planning meetings to support operational efficiency.
- Schedule installation handovers and snagging reviews.

Customer Service & Communication
- Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
- Keep clients informed throughout the installation process.
- Conduct customer care calls following service visits.
- Handle incoming telephone enquiries and provide administrative support.

Administration & Systems
- Maintain accurate customer records using SIMPRO and FieldMotion.
- Input new customer information into company systems.
- Prepare job packs, installation paperwork, and welcome packs.
- Scan and upload documentation to internal systems.
- Produce quotations for parts and labour and support quotation preparation.
- Compile weekly and monthly operational reports and figures.
- Chase outstanding quotations when required.
- Prepare and collate monthly timesheets.

Resource & Compliance Support

Order equipment and materials for installation projects.

Monitor van stock levels and arrange replenishment where required.

Support training administration, including maintaining training records and assisting apprentice development.

Assist with health and safety administration, including engineer audits, vehicle checks, PPE monitoring, toolbox talks, and compliance documentation.

Support annual audits and wider business compliance activities.

What We're Looking For

Excellent organisational and planning skills.

Strong communication and customer service abilities.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a busy environment.

High attention to detail and accuracy.

Confident using Microsoft Office and business management systems.

Experience in scheduling, coordination, administration, or customer service is desirable.

Experience within the fire, security, construction, engineering, or service industries would be advantageous but is not essential.

Benefits

26,400 per annum (pro rata).

Pension scheme.

Private health insurance.

Life insurance.

Employee Assistance Programme.

25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (pro rata), with the option to purchase additional leave.

Clear opportunities for career progression within the Ranger Group.

Supportive and collaborative team environment.

Equal Opportunities

Universal Fire & Security and the Ranger Group are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, or sexual orientation.

Apply today and become part of a growing team where your contribution truly makes a difference.

title: Medical Receptionist/Administrator

title: Receptionist/Administration
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for someone to join Dean Cross Surgery Reception team. Dean Cross Surgery is situated in Plymstock with a practice population of around 10,000 patients. Delivering great customer service and outstanding care is a priority for every member of our team. This role is pinnacle to us achieving this, you will be the first point of contact patients have with the practice. Your ability to always remain professional and polite is essential. Your listening skills and supportive nature will help direct patients to the right service for their needs. If you are ready to learn new skills, flexible in your approach to work, conscientious and enjoy working as part of a supportive busy team, this could be the perfect opportunity for you. The working pattern will be: Monday- 08.00-18.30 Thursday 13.00-18.30 Friday 08.00-18.00 A total of 25 hrs per week Answer telephone calls, listening with empathy and compassion to ensure that patients are directed to the right service to meet their needs. Awareness of practice policies and procedures with the confidence to make reasonable adjustments to meet the needs of individuals. Manage the front desk, welcoming visitors and supporting patients and colleagues to ensure smooth running of the service. Provide administration support to clinicians/service providers when requested. Manage the waiting rooms, keeping these tidy and well stocked. Ensure patient encounters are recorded accurately on clinical systems. Monitor and respond to emails into the surgery. Prepare patient registration packs and ensure patient registrations are completed and processed correctly and timely. Monitor tasks, results, and referrals, following up queries and ensuring patients are kept informed of relevant results and treatment pathways. Ensure your work area and patient accessible areas are safe and free of adverse risk to health. Work as part of the team to open the surgery at the start of the day, close and secure the surgery at the end of the day. Within this role you will also be responsible for overseeing patient records.
